changes_from_source: 原题涉及多轮追问和地图获取；固定城市坐标，提供原创简化地图，无地图 API key。
brief_en: Make a 20-second map travel story: Los Angeles to New York to Paris. Use cities.json and world-map.svg. Keep map projection and coordinates consistent, draw the route progressively, and move the camera along it. At Paris reveal a dimensional Eiffel Tower built with code. The provided map is a deliberately simplified geographic diagram, not a navigation map.
brief_zh: 制作 20 秒洛杉矶—纽约—巴黎旅行地图视频。使用 cities.json 与 world-map.svg，保持地图投影和坐标一致，逐步绘制路线并让镜头跟随。在巴黎用代码制作有立体感的埃菲尔铁塔。给定地图是简化地理示意图，不用于导航。
